detail.longDescription: 🦖 HTMLButtonElement: command property ☑️ Newly available (from Dec 2025) https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/API/HTMLButtonElement/command The command property of the HTMLButtonElement interface gets and sets the action to be performed on an element being controlled by this button. For this to have an effect, commandfor must be set. # webdev
